description: Sleep in whole cycles so you wake in light sleep: given a wake-up time, the bedtimes for 6, 5, 4 or 3 cycles; given a bedtime (or "now"), the wake-up times. Defaults: 90-minute cycles (70–110) and 15 minutes to fall asleep (0–60). With mode "bed"/"now" it also lists nap alarms (20, 30, 60 min and one full cycle). 12- or 24-hour clock. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/sleep-calc/

fallAsleepMinutes.description: Minutes it takes you to fall asleep.

mode.description: wake: I must wake at "time"; bed: I go to bed at "time"; now: I go to bed now (server clock).

time.description: "HH:MM" 24 h: the wake-up time (wake) or bedtime (bed). Default 07:00 / 23:00.

name: calc_sleep
title: Sleep cycle calculator
